subject: English
guide_solution: Paragraph writing Junk Food People around the world take different kinds of food. The foods that people commonly eat are wheat, rice, meat, fish and pulses. People also eat potato, vegetables, beef, mutton, chicken, eggs and fruits. These foods are frequently taken by the people across the world. Besides these foods, the people of different countries take another kind of food. They take these foods for their special taste and fashion. They are taken as snack. These types of food are called junk foods. These kinds of food are very attractive and are available. Junk food is a kind of food which is eaten by people for its pungent taste, but it has nofood value. It is a great fun to eat junk food and it looks very appealing, but it is not good for the body. It contains some chemicals to make it tasty. it mainly contains a lot of animal fat and sugar. I sometimes eat junk food and it tastes nice to me. Foods like chips, burgers, crisps, cakes, biscuits etc. are high in animal fats. Sweets and fizzy drinks like cola and lemonade are high in sugar. Junk food is not good for health. The animal fats form fatty tissues in our body that cause harm to our skin. The sugar in the junk food damages our teeth. Junk food is wanting in the vitamins and minerals that we need for our health. It does more harm than good. So, we should take various home made foods like vegetables, rice which are more fresh and nutritious. We should always remember that we eat to live not live to eat.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 104 — Al-Amin Jamia Islamia High School, Sylhet
